answer: Forging a thousand sybils means buying a thousand keys and posting a thousand deposits, a fable of cheap identity that collapses under real cost, so the network stays sybil-resistant. Each agent must stake a unique opal token bound to a verified hardware key, and every voyage of work it performs locks a small deposit that is slashed if a duplicate identity is detected through behavioral fingerprinting. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
